rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');
SET @prov5 := (SELECT hoscode FROM sys_config c INNER JOIN chospital h ON c.provincecode=h.provcode AND h.hostype in(1));
SET @yearpop:=(SELECT max(b_year) FROM k_mental_pop WHERE cat_id ='x68');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_mental_x68(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) NOT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) NOT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	pop int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,	
	k varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
	target int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	result1 int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	result2 int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	result3 int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_mental_x68 WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_mental_x68
(
SELECT
@id,@prov5,CONCAT(@prov_c,'000000') areacode,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year
,(SELECT p.pop FROM k_mental_pop p WHERE p.prov_code in(@prov_c) AND cat_id IN('x68') 
  AND b_year IN(@yearpop))  as pop 
,(SELECT p.k FROM k_mental_pop p WHERE p.prov_code in(@prov_c) AND cat_id IN('x68') 
  AND b_year IN(@yearpop) ) as k
,(SELECT p.pop_k FROM k_mental_pop p WHERE p.prov_code in(@prov_c) AND cat_id IN('x68') 
   AND b_year IN(@yearpop))  as pop_k
,IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.cid) as result1 
				FROM tmp_x68 f INNER JOIN chospital h ON f.diag_hospcode=h.hoscode 
			WHERE h.provcode in(@prov_c) AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,f.birth,f.diag_date_serv) >= 15 
			GROUP BY h.provcode),0) as r1
,IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.cid) as result2 
				FROM tmp_x68 f  
				WHERE  TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,f.birth,f.diag_date_serv) >= 15  AND SUBSTR(f.final_addr,1,2)  in(@prov_c)
         GROUP BY SUBSTR(f.final_addr,1,2)),0) as r2 
,IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.cid) as result3
				FROM tmp_x68 f  
				WHERE  TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,f.birth,f.diag_date_serv) >= 15 
							AND (LENGTH(TRIM(f.final_addr)) =0 OR ISNULL(f.final_addr))),0) as r3 
);
